pr_metadata.title: refactor(nativeha): rename the CRR Native HA stack to nativeha-rhel-crr / NHARCAPP (#1104)
pr_metadata.summary: Full atomic rename of the CRR Native HA stack (key nativeha-rhel->nativeha-rhel-crr, short NHAR->NHARC/NHARCAPP, groups nha_rhel_crr_a/b, nodes nha-rhel-crr-*) across topology, the composing playbooks, parity/clusterboard/observability, and tests, so the CRR stack still works and can coexist with the coming IRR sibling; async behaviour is byte-for-byte unchanged.
pr_metadata.notes: Plan Task 2 of epic #227. Scope went beyond the plan's headline file list where the CRR functional path required it (site-nativeha-tls.yml, validate-nativeha-log-lifecycle.yml, the nativeha-state service template, fault suite, and the qmboard UID test which derives lab-qm-nharc from the short) — these are called out in the commit body. Box name mq-nativeha-rhel9 and bake stem nativeha-rhel deliberately kept (they are the box, not the stack). DNS FQDNs regenerate from node names (dns.py); only the hardcoded our_conn/app_conn CONNAME literals were edited. WAN IPs left as literals for Task 4 to parameterize. Validation green: 1200 tests, 100% branch coverage, full lint/type/audit.
